value.rationale: This is a structurally motivated postcritically finite sequence in a recent rank-one border-collision model, not an arbitrary isolated parameter sample. The physical metric entropy vanishes while compact topological entropy tends to log 2, and an exact rare-event pressure crossover remains nontrivial. These different statistical limits show that a singular parameter family can retain exponentially many itineraries while typical expansion disappears, with quantitative CLT and pressure usable for finite-time observations.
